items.item:
3. No operation schema has a field for the current time; a request adding one
   is refused as an unknown field.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a19_request_cannot_supply_time]
statements:
```text
kernel_timestamp -> clock_module.now
request_field(current_time) -> refused
service_timestamp -/> kernel_timestamp
stored(monotonic_reading) -> never
```

verdicts.item:
3. No operation schema has a field for the current time; a request adding one
   is refused as an unknown field.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a19_request_cannot_supply_time]
statements:
```text
kernel_timestamp -> clock_module.now
request_field(current_time) -> refused
service_timestamp -/> kernel_timestamp
stored(monotonic_reading) -> never
```
verdicts.why: The selected test detects added current-time and timestamp fields as invalid_request across the operation catalogue and checks that a created record did not use the supplied value. It does not prove that kernel timestamps come from clock_module.now, that service timestamps never become kernel timestamps, or that monotonic readings are never stored.
